posts.preview: The promotion of decent work is a shared responsibility that requires the commitment of all stakeholders. It should not be viewed as the sole responsibility of the Ministry of Justice, Labour and Industrial Relations, employers, and trade unions

Regional Councils also have an important role to play by coordinating social partners within their regions to address issues related to the promotion of decent work and to foster collaborative efforts that improve working conditions and employment opportunities See less
